mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 48 degrees, feeling like 44 near the Verona Public Library.

City residents should be aware that asphalt repairs are scheduled for November 9 and 10, affecting Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Also, the city welcomes Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the EMS team this November.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tonight, check out ART House 360 for live entertainment, and make sure to head to Hop Haus Brewing on Thursday for their weekly trivia night.

In a report from October 25, Verona police officers arrested a 40-year-old local man for O W I after he was discovered stopped in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for an extended period.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
